name: Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench: Intel Max 1550 x1, vLLM 0.5.2-XPU, Llama-3-8B FP16, 128in/128out, batch 64
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Argonne LLM-Inference-Bench, arXiv:2411.00136, All_results.csv). FP16/BF16 weights, 128 in / 128 out. Throughput = batch*(in+out)/end-to-end latency = AGGREGATE over the batch, NOT per-request decode tok/s. Batch 64, 1x Max 1550. Latency 7.715s.
